# A Study of Inline Tests and Code Co-evolution

## Projects and data

This repository contains the following data at locations in the following hyperlinks:

* [All the inline tests we wrote](data/tests)
* [All the inline tests generated by inline-test generation tools](data/gen-tests)

### Data for Bug353

1. `data/sstubs.json`: Unfiltered version of all sstubs mined.
2. `data/sstubs_merged_mvn_src_bt_classify_ts.json`: After filtering, before running experiments.
3. `data/sstubs_merged_mvn_src_bt_classify_ts_res_auto.json`: Dataset with result from automatically-generated inline tests only.
4. `data/sstubs_merged_mvn_src_bt_classify_ts_res.json`: Dataset with result from both automatically-generated and manually-written inline tests.

### Data for project revisions

Data for all project revisions is under `data/revisions/`, organized by project name.

### Other data files

- `data/all_projects.txt`: A list of projects we mine from, where the first `_` should be used as the separator between organization and repository name on GitHub.
- `data/projects_with_inline_tests.txt`: A list of a subset of projects such that the project has at least one inline test associated with it.
- `ONE_TO_ONE.txt`: All the 1:1s we discovered.

## Repository structure

| Directory          | Purpose                                                      |
| ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Docker             | Contains a Dockerfile that can be built to run experiments.  |
| data               | Contains project information and experiment data.            |
| scripts            | Contains the scripts to run experiments.                     |
| local_dependencies | Contains some Maven extensions that the experiment needs.    |

## Usage

### Prerequisites

* An x86-64 architecture machine
* Ubuntu 22.04
* [Docker](https://docs.docker.com/get-docker/)
* [GNU Parallel](https://www.gnu.org/software/parallel/)

### Setup

First, you need to build a Docker image (might take a short while). Run the following commands in terminal:

```bash
docker build -f Docker/Dockerfile . --tag=ssb4it
```

### Run experiment

#### Run the experiment to test the bug-finding effectiveness of inline tests

##### With auto-generated inline tests only

```bash
cd scripts/itest_in_evo
bash all.sh ../../data/sstubs_merged_mvn_src_bt_classify_ts.json tmp_commands.sh
20 generate_and_run_inline_tests_auto useExli
```

Data for this experiment run will be organized under `data/generated-data/generate_and_run_inline_tests_auto`.

##### With auto-generated and manually-written inline tests

```bash
cd scripts/itest_in_evo
bash all.sh ../../data/sstubs_merged_mvn_src_bt_classify_ts.json tmp_commands2.sh
20 generate_and_run_inline_tests useExli useManual
```

Data for this experiment run will be organized under `data/generated-data/generate_and_run_inline_tests`.

#### Run auto-generated inline tests against the evolution dataset (Evo802)

```bash
cd scripts/itest_in_evo
bash all.sh ../../data/ONE_TO_ONE_WITH_ITESTS.txt tmp_commands3.sh
20 generate_and_run_inline_tests_auto useExli
```

Data for this experiment run will be organized under `data/generated-data/itest_in_evo`.

#### Reproduce all 1:1, 1:M, M:1, M:M changes we mined

```bash
cd scripts
bash find_changed_ts_for_all.sh ../data/all_projects.txt
```

Data for this experiment run will be organized under `data/generated-data/mine-ts-changes`.

The curated 1:M and M:1 changes are under `data/one_to_many` and `data/many_to_one`.

## Results

After you finished executing the command, you will find their data [here](data/generated-data). Path: `data/generated-data`

Note that these locations are generated only after the experiment run is finished. They do not exist before experiment run.
